name: What accessibility challenges are common in Denver and Aurora area homes?

mainEntity.name: What accessibility challenges are common in Denver and Aurora area homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Homeowners in the Denver metro area and Aurora frequently remodel older ranches, split-levels, and two-story homes featuring narrow entryways, framed-in fiberglass tubs, and raised exterior thresholds. Our work across communities like Centennial, Parker, and Greenwood Village often focuses on widening older standard interior doorways, reinforcing drywall with solid stud blocking, and replacing high-step tubs with curbless tile showers. Understanding regional home construction styles allows our team to address common subfloor and framing layouts efficiently while updating residences for barrier-free living.
acceptedAnswer.description: Local homes often feature narrow interior halls, raised tub steps, and multi-level thresholds that require doorway widening and curbless tile shower conversions.
